Annotate rows and columns

Source: R/anno.R
calor_anno.Rd

Adds annotation tracks beside the heatmap: coloured bars for categorical data, bar charts for numeric data. Each column of a data frame becomes one track. Tracks align cell to cell with the heatmap, follow its ordering and splits, and get their own legends.

Usage

calor_anno(
  top = NULL,
  bottom = NULL,
  left = NULL,
  right = NULL,
  type = "auto",
  size = 4,
  colours = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

Arguments

top, bottom

Annotations for columns: a data frame with one row per column of the matrix, a vector, or a named list of vectors. Values are matched by name when names are present, else by position.

left, right

The same, for rows.

type

Track type: "auto" (tile for categorical, bar for numeric), "tile", "bar", "point", "line", or "glyph" (a point per item: shapes for categories, sizes for numbers). One value, or a named vector keyed by track name.

size

Track thickness in millimetres; one value or named by track.

colours

Named list: for a categorical track, a vector of colours (optionally named by level); for a numeric track, a single fill colour.

show_legend

Draw legends for categorical tracks.

Value

An object to add to a ggcalor() plot with +.

Examples

m <- matrix(rnorm(200), 20, 10, dimnames = list(paste0("g", 1:20), paste0("s", 1:10)))
meta <- data.frame(group = rep(c("A", "B"), 5), dose = 1:10)
ggcalor(m) + calor_anno(top = meta, left = data.frame(score = runif(20)))
